meta_description:
126 likes, 3 comments - amitbhawani on August 26, 2026: "Apple’s 2026 lineup could be CRAZY! 

iPhone 18 Pro is expected with the new A20 Pro 2nm chip, variable aperture camera and a smaller Dynamic Island.

But that’s just the beginning.

Apple’s FIRST Foldable iPhone - Expected ~5.5” outer + ~7.8” folding display, with rumours even pointing towards Touch ID making a comeback.

TOUCHSCREEN MacBook Pro - Apple is reportedly working on an OLED MacBook with M6-generation chips and something it has resisted for years: a touchscreen.

AirPods WITH CAMERAS?!
Not necessarily for taking photos. The idea could be to give Siri and Visual Intelligence the ability to understand your surroundings.

Imagine looking at something and simply asking Siri, “What is this?”

The iPhone 18 Pro looks good, but the Foldable iPhone, touchscreen MacBook and camera AirPods are what could make Apple’s next generation genuinely different.

These are based on current leaks and reports and are not all officially confirmed by Apple.

Which one would you actually buy?
#Apple #iPhone18Pro #iPhoneFold #MacBookPro #AirPods AppleIntelligence iPhone18 Apple2026".
